author: ojiudezue
title: v5.90.1 shipped: DP drain-target value-stamp — EVSE drain precedence drains to the composed off-peak floor, not a stale static knob
summary: DP was pausing EV charging and draining the house battery toward a stale re-derived floor (coincidentally the static reserve knob, ~10) instead of the composed off-peak drain target the battery strategy actually clamped and acted on that same tick. On a day-evening plug-in that over-drains the battery below the forecast-safe floor and buys expensive peak grid import to re-attain. The fix threads the emitter's this-tick composed target verbatim into the DP decision, deletes the re-derivation, debounces the None-release 2 ticks for responsiveness without flap, and fixes shadow blind-hold precedence. Root cause was code-verified, orchestrator-verified by hand (mutation on the stamp site + full-suite name-diff clean), and operator gave the Tier-3 go.

refs.release_notes: EVSE Drain Precedence now consumes the battery strategy's this-tick composed off-peak drain target verbatim (value-stamp), deleting the stale re-derivation that coincidentally matched the static reserve knob (Bug Class #63). Adds a 2-tick debounce on the None-release to kill single-tick oscillation, and fixes shadow-eval blind-hold precedence. Tier-3, orchestrator-verified, 0 new test regressions.
